messages:
maya: Heads up — staging apply failed when merging my PR that reorders NAT + ENI attachments for GPU pool. Need someone to take a look before we open the merge window. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/3427 :wave:

ops-bot: terraform apply failed in staging (job #5123)
Error: Error attaching ENI: AttachmentConflict: attachment is in use

Full logs: https://ci.redwood/ml/5123
@maya set canary_hold=true

sam: Poking now. Do we have the exact plan diff? can you paste the relevant resource blocks? :eyes:

maya: plan snippet:
```hcl
- resource "aws_network_interface_attachment" "gpu_eni" {
    device_index = 1
    instance_id = aws_instance.gpu.id
  }
+ resource "aws_nat_gateway" "gpu_nat" {
    allocation_id = ...
  }
```
It's a reorder; I think ordering caused ENI attach to race with nat route propagation.

lee: If canary_hold=true we shouldn't merge. Sam — if you find it's a timing thing we can add explicit depends_on or a null_resource with local-exec to wait.

sam: I can repro locally against staging account. Quick test: taint aws_network_interface_attachment.gpu_eni then apply. If it retries it might succeed. ETA 30m.

anita: Heads up from networking: NAT gateway creation can take ~1-2 min to be routable, so if ENI attach happens before route propagation some backfill fails. We usually add retries at the driver layer; ordering is more deterministic.

jen: If this blocks the rollout we can temporarily revert PR and open follow-up to add stable ordering + retry logic. What's the risk of leaving in place?

maya: Risk is staging instability only — but want to keep merge window clean. If folks want revert I'll open revert PR. Otherwise Sam, ping when you have repro.

sam: Repro done, failure matches. Adding explicit depends_on aws_nat_gateway.gpu_nat on ENI attachment fixes apply. I'll open a small fix PR referencing #3427 and request 2 approvals. Will also add test step in staging apply to wait for NAT propagation.

ops-bot: canary_hold cleared by maya at 2188887890 :white_check_mark:

sam: PR opened https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/3430 — small fix, includes depends_on + wait script. Requesting 2 approvals. :rocket:
